findings.message: `format` is passed straight to `Intl.DateTimeFormat` as `timeZoneName`. The "shortGeneric" and "longGeneric" values (ES2021 Intl.DateTimeFormat extension) are missing from older runtimes, such as Safari < 15.4 and older Node/ICU builds. Those throw a RangeError there. Plain-JS callers can also pass any other string, such as "shortOffset", which the type doesn't cover and the docs don't mention. Either document the minimum runtime support or validate/fall back, so a cosmetic helper doesn't crash on some platforms.
